definition: After established whole-protein frame alignment to last observation, W=(X_seed17-X_seed29)/sqrt(2) removes the shared conditional mean. No time centering. E[W_t dot W_u] estimates conditional stochastic covariance assuming independent source draws. Normalized finite-window ratios are descriptive, not unbiased correlation estimates. Increment cosine uses only future-to-future increments, not an inserted observed zero.
interpretation: A/B stochastic position residuals are NOT independent across all frames: their lag1 and lag8 moments are positive. Do not claim universally independent atoms or independent future frames.

All four MD-only A/B runs and both static-pretrained runs nevertheless have adjacent stochastic increment cosines near -0.5. This is compatible with a shared/slow random offset plus substantial framewise jitter; it does not establish that decomposition or Gaussian independent noise as a causal model.

PVB has substantially stronger short-lag stochastic position persistence and less negative adjacent stochastic increments under the same transformed observable. Higher persistence is not itself correctness, and PVB still loses some previously reported path/motion scores.

Static pretraining improves geometry but has not removed the characteristic weak local stochastic temporal coupling. This sharpens the reason to test dynamic temporal interaction changes rather than decoder-only clean reconstruction.

The prepared temporal-order candidate remains untrained and unvalidated. These observations do not prove that swapping token/temporal order will fix the issue. Keep source and losses fixed for its proposed controlled comparison; do not add inference-only correlated source noise.
limitations: Only two generated draws per condition; mean-signal estimator can be negative and is not clipped
Only one true MD future per condition, so no real conditional stochastic covariance target or covariance error is identifiable here
Reusable development48, not sealed confirmation; native PVB H1 and training/input resource differences remain
Alignment changes the observable; use same established whole-protein convention, not component-specific fitting
No equilibrium, thermodynamic, mechanistic, or correct conditional-mean claim
